note: Sapper's Path v4 M4, the Gallery's pictures: every candidate with its source, author, license and date (generated ones: model, prompt and seed). keep false: dropped, with why. The converter reads file (tools/gallery-src.py writes it from raw); kind picks the converter's settings (tools/gallery-config.json convert.kinds), and a line may override mask, crop [x0, y0, x1, y1] (fractions), box [columns, rows], bg, outline, colours. The Gallery shows the kept pictures in the order of `order`. v4.4a: candidate "v4.4a" marks the pictures offered for Gallery 61-100 (the new pictures of our own and the 28 M4 spares, which keep their M4 why); Peter picks 40 from tools/shots-v4.4/candidates-sheet.png. Campaign v6 (2026-10-06, tools/quest-bake.js): order is the campaign's 50 side quests (tools/campaign-quests/quests.json); the 26 new pictures are kind "outlined" (converted through tools/land.js boardOf from tools/campaign-quests/src, bake tools/quest-bake.js); the 36 that left for Zen World 1 keep their lines here.
